lines.say: Nineteen forty eight to now. Who grew the most?
Start with the neighbours: Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria.
Watch Israel from the bottom of the list.
By nineteen sixty seven, it passes Lebanon.
Today: ten million people, from six hundred thousand.
Almost seventeen times bigger in one lifetime.
So the next time someone says Israel is too small to matter:

end.balance: Big is not the point. *Growth* is.
